data.one_liner: Generate ESC/POS commands for thermal receipt printers.
data.what_it_does: Provides core Flutter and Dart classes to build tickets and format text, tables, images, barcodes, and QR codes into ESC/POS byte commands suitable for thermal receipt printers via network, bluetooth, or USB plugins.
use_when: You need to format receipts and print tickets for thermal printers in Flutter
You are building a POS application that communicates with receipt printers
avoid_when: You are printing standard documents like PDFs to desktop printers
You need high-level printing UI dialogs instead of raw byte commands
strengths: Supports multiple paper sizes, formatting styles, tables, and images
Supports various printer profiles and code tables for international text
Works well with network and bluetooth companion printer plugins
weaknesses: Printer hardware support varies widely and some features may not work on specific thermal printer models
Only generates byte commands; actual transmission requires other packages like network or bluetooth plugins
data.setup_notes: Load the default capability profile and initialize the Generator class with your chosen paper size.
